```{python}
#| echo: false

annual_keys = ["permno", "year"]
msf = (
    load_parquet("msf", "crsp")
    .filter(pl.col("date").is_between(pl.date(1987, 12, 1), pl.date(2012, 12, 31)))
    .with_columns(year=pl.col("date").dt.year())
)
capitalizations = (
    load_parquet("sizes", "eap")
    .filter(pl.col("month").dt.month() == 12)
    .select("permno", year=pl.col("month").dt.year(), MktCap="cap", Size="log_cap")
)
book_to_market = (
    load_parquet("book_to_market", "eap")
    .filter(pl.col("month").dt.month() == 12)
    .select("permno", year=pl.col("month").dt.year(), BM="bm_raw")
)

annual_stock_returns = (
    msf.filter(pl.col("year") >= 1989, pl.col("ret").is_finite())
    .group_by(annual_keys)
    .agg(gross_stock=(1 + pl.col("ret")).product())
)
annual_risk_free = (
    load_parquet("factors_monthly", "ff")
    .with_columns(year=pl.col("date").dt.year())
    .filter(pl.col("year").is_between(1989, 2012))
    .group_by("year")
    .agg(gross_rf=(1 + pl.col("rf")).product(), n=pl.col("rf").count())
    .filter(pl.col("n") == 12)
)
next_year = (
    annual_stock_returns.join(annual_risk_free, on="year", validate="m:1")
    .select("permno", year=pl.col("year") - 1,
            excess=100 * (pl.col("gross_stock") - pl.col("gross_rf")))
)
annual_panel = (
    annual_beta
    .join(capitalizations, on=annual_keys, how="left", validate="1:1")
    .join(book_to_market, on=annual_keys, how="left", validate="1:1")
    .join(next_year, on=annual_keys, how="left", validate="1:1")
    .collect()
)
```
